name: ABNT NBR 9077 (emergency exit)
references: ABNT NBR 9077:2001 (saídas de emergência em edifícios), 4.4 dimensionamento, 4.7 escadas, 4.8 guarda-corpos
checked: Checked against the text of ABNT NBR 9077:2001 by a contributor (pull request #386).
note: For an emergency exit stair. In most states the fire brigade's own instruction rules over this standard (São Paulo's IT 11, Santa Catarina's IN 09): change the rules to its numbers. The width here is two units of passage (1.10 m); the standard sizes it by the population. Balanced winders are allowed (4.7.9.1) except on smoke-proof stairs and in occupancy groups F and H (4.7.9.2). Successive flights may differ by 5 mm in riser at most (4.7.3.1); within a flight the risers are equal, 0.5 mm the tolerance. An internal stair's guard may drop to 0.92 m (4.8.1.2) and an external one more than 12 m up needs 1.30 m (4.8.1.3). Headroom and the most risers in a flight are not in the standard: forgiving numbers; it asks 3 risers to a flight at least.

sources.stairs.riser: NBR 9077:2001 4.7.3.1, a riser in its range
sources.stairs.going: NBR 9077:2001 4.7.3.1, a tread in its range
sources.stairs.width_min: NBR 9077:2001 4.4.2, two units of passage (sized by the population)
sources.stairs.headroom: Not in the standard: a forgiving number
sources.stairs.flight_risers_max: Not in the standard: a forgiving number (the standard asks 3 at least)
sources.stairs.landing_rule: NBR 9077:2001 4.7.3.3, by the formula for straight runs
sources.stairs.landing_length: NBR 9077:2001 4.7.3.3, and no shorter than the width
sources.stairs.winders: NBR 9077:2001 4.7.9.1, balanced winders (not on smoke-proof stairs or in groups F and H, 4.7.9.2)
sources.stairs.walk_line_offset: NBR 9077:2001 3.32, 0.55 m from the inner edge
sources.stairs.winder_narrow_min: NBR 9077:2001 4.7.3.1 and 4.7.9.1, 0.15 m at the narrow end
sources.stairs.uniformity: NBR 9077:2001 4.7.3.1, equal within a flight (0.5 mm tolerance)
sources.stairs.guard_min: NBR 9077:2001 4.8.1.2, 1.05 m (0.92 m inside, 1.30 m outside over 12 m)
